speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To better understand your condition, could you please describe the specific symptoms you are experiencing and when they first began? Additionally, do you have any significant past medical history or family history of neurological disorders that you are aware of?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Is this symptom progression happening suddenly over hours or days, or has it developed gradually over weeks or months? Also, have you noticed any accompanying symptoms such as double vision, slurred speech, or severe headaches?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you currently experience any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your limbs, and have you had any recent episodes of fever or flu-like symptoms? Given your history of Crohn's disease and natalizumab use, I need to rule out opportunistic infections or autoimmune demyelination. REQUEST TEST: MRI_of_the_brain_and_spine
